newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly molasses report - June 9.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly molasses report - June 9.

text.p: Prices on sugarcane molasses were mostly steady in the week ended June 7, with the exception of Savannah which was $5.00 higher per ton, USDA Market News said in their weekly National Molasses report.

Molasses supplies are moderate to good with light to moderate demand. Domestic molasses usage remains light to moderate. Lower prices for competitive energy sources and grazing continue to pressure molasses prices, according to USDA.
